responses.text: Sir! I don't know what happened, a bunch of Legionnaires just stormed into the power station.
I{stutters} don't know sir. There was some talk of them entering through the clogged intake tunnels, but I don't have any confirmation.
On my way up here there was some chatter about their commander, the Legate I think he's called, set up at some kind of base on the eastern bank.
